_notes: Ep 8 — 3 simultaneous local cams (offsets 0,0,0; host-confirmed).
COLD OPEN: 6 teasers, ~74s, ends on the perp finale tease (C6).
REORDER: the check-in/baby-vomit block is MOVED mid-show as a palate
cleanser after the guardrails debate; only the welcome stays up front.
v2 FIX (Jackson): the S1/S3a split at master 38.0 landed INSIDE Chris's
10.9s 'huge shout out to Jackson ... barely carry a third of it, massive
props' compliment (VAD: chris speaks 34.28-45.22 continuously), so its
tail played at 18:28 mid-show. S1 now ends at 45.71 — the next true
all-silent gap — keeping the whole compliment in the intro. S3a then
opens on 'Speaking of stools, Chris, what's going on with the gamer
thumb', which is a better check-in cold start anyway.
v2 (Jackson): S2a starts at 444.66 not 443.48, cutting Jackson's 'And I
think' so the marquee opens on 'This is the perfect time to transition'.
444.66 is the whisper+energy-verified 'think'->'this' boundary (energy
dip 0.0162 at 444.64-444.66); snap() leaves it alone (verified). No new
splice is created: S2a's m0 is already a block boundary (S1 ends at
master 45.71), so this only changes where the new segment starts.
v2 (Jackson): PERP DASHBOARD STAYS UP once it starts — corner PiP is now
continuous from 2452 to the end of the perp recording (3697.5) across
S5/S6a/S6b/S7a/S7b/S8, instead of three short windows. Master time runs
monotonically across those blocks, so the wall-clock-synced dashboard
never rewinds or spoils. remote_cut.py still blanks it under overlays.
v2 (Jackson): 'always transition sound + wipe' — every segment transition
now has BOTH an sfx (render.json) and a wipe.mov accent (render.json
anim, which was an empty array in v1 — that is why no swipes showed).
CUT (requested): Jackson's 'I work in fintech' admission — MAIN body ends at
2721.97, resumes 2768.23, + mute jackson 2768.30-2771.00 to kill the tail.
CUT (requested): baby-vomit story trimmed (concoction riff, allergist plan
and ghost/lethargic beat removed; 'we grossed out all of our listeners'
button kept).
CUT (length): ~7 min of BIP-110 fork minutiae (futures markets/Bitfinex,
pool-switching, Bitmain covert ASIC boost, Luke Dash Jr), Jackson's
unanswered geo-fence war-tool question (1436-1465), Chris's Ethereum-Classic
replay-attack detour (1833-1894), the OCC-charter tail (2722-2748), the
'we went red' dead patch (2786-2817) and the repetitive multi-rail hedging
in the standards-war wrap (3522-3558).

AUDIO: gain_target 0.006 (NOT 0.028 - that clipped edited_raw.mov at 0 dBFS,
  192k flat-topped samples; jackson x2.88 alone peaked 2.06). loudnorm still
  lands -16 LUFS so the quieter intermediate costs nothing.
v2 (Jackson): MORE multi-person shots. group_thresh 0.30->0.25 and
group_hold 1.2->1.0 so short vocal reactions (laughs, 'yeah', 'mhm')
latch a duo/trio; plus react_thresh 0.60 which consumes motion.json
from remote_motion.py so SILENT visible reactions (laughing, nodding,
gesturing) also widen the shot. The speaker is always kept in frame, so
a reaction can only ever widen — never cut away from who is talking.
Every m0/m1 was verified to land in an all-silent (VAD union) gap via spans.py.

Swept the pair: 0.18/0.35 gave 56.5% multi-person (too much - the split screen stops meaning anything), 0.25/0.60 gives 34.0% (duo 26.4 + trio 7.6) vs v1's 14.2%, keeping solo the 66% majority. motion.json validated: flagged silent frames carry 6.6x the resting baseline and 2x the motion of SPEAKING, i.e. real gestures/laughs, well clear of the 0.21 noise floor.
